description: This file is a shell script used for controlling hotspot and hostapd services on a device, including restarting hostapd, enabling/disabling hotspot interfaces, and checking the status of the hotspot.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd process and reconfigures network interfaces related to the hotspot

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd process and reinitializes network interfaces for hostapd
